--- pipe_aggregate_full_table.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) total_sales DESC

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:  11,
        Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: -1,
            Expr:   &ast.CountStarExpr{
              Count:  24,
              Rparen: 31,
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    33,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 36,
                NameEnd: 37,
                Name:    "n",
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: 63,
            Expr:   &ast.CallExpr{
              Rparen: 49,
              Func:   &ast.Path{
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 39,
                    NameEnd: 42,
                    Name:    "SUM",
                  },
                },
              },
              Args: []ast.Arg{
                &ast.ExprArg{
                  Expr: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 43,
                    NameEnd: 49,
                    Name:    "amount",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    -1,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 51,
                NameEnd: 62,
                Name:    "total_sales",
              },
            },
            Dir: "DESC",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) total_sales DESC
